checks: Confirm exact input cell and symmetry tolerance.
Compare atom/site mapping before using BPOSCAR or PPOSCAR.
symmetry-inspection.caution: Detected symmetry is tolerance-dependent and is not proof that a structure should be standardized for a scientific workflow.

commands.external_step: Run one accepted VASP force calculation for every displaced supercell.

checks: Converge the supercell, displacement amplitude, electronic settings, k mesh, and force precision.
Preserve displacement order and require one completed force result per displacement.
Inspect residual forces and force-constant drift.
vasp-finite-displacement.caution: The documented 2x2x2 cell and auto primitive matrix are examples, not convergence evidence.

commands.external_step: Run one accepted QE pw.x force calculation for every displaced supercell.

checks: Retain QE force units and exact structure/order identity.
Validate every pw.x parent with the QE calculation skill.
Converge supercell, displacement, k mesh, cutoffs, SCF, and force thresholds.
qe-finite-displacement.caution: Do not use stale current-page examples that call setup flags on phonopy rather than phonopy-init.

checks: Record random-displacement settings and output hashes.
Choose snapshot count and amplitude from an explicit fitting/validation plan.
random-displacements.caution: This finite-count initialization example is not the finite-temperature random-displacement workflow.

commands.external_step: Run and validate a VASP DFPT force-constant calculation.

checks: Confirm VASP DFPT prerequisites, structure, atom order, units, and completion.
Check the force-constant shape and drift before properties.
Install and record seekpath when using auto paths.
Verify primitive matrix, reciprocal convention, labels, endpoints, and path density.
Preserve signed frequencies and inspect eigenvectors for questionable modes.
band-auto.caution: An automatic path is a convention choice, not universal scientific ground truth.

required_files: phonopy_params.yaml containing nac_params, or a compatible BORN file

checks: Verify the BORN/dielectric provenance, primitive-cell atom order, units, q direction near Gamma, and path convention.
Confirm logs show NAC was actually enabled.
band-explicit-with-nac.caution: In v4, do not add phonopy --nac; NAC is automatic when data are present and --nonac is the explicit opt-out.

checks: Converge the q mesh and broadening/range controls for the target DOS feature.
Check normalization, units, primitive cell, and imaginary-frequency handling.
total-dos.caution: The official page's 31x31x31 value is an example and its embedded output banner is older than 4.3.1.

checks: Use phonopy -v to confirm primitive-cell atom order behind projection indices.
Check whether Cartesian projection is needed and converge q mesh/broadening.
Check sum of projections against total DOS under the selected convention.
projected-dos.caution: Projection indices refer to atoms in the primitive cell; they must not be inferred from the original input order.

checks: Converge q mesh and temperature grid.
Check the unit block in thermal_properties.yaml and treatment of imaginary modes.
Do not interpret harmonic constant-volume results as QHA constant-pressure results.
thermal-properties.caution: Default temperature settings and example mesh are not campaign acceptance criteria.

checks: Verify q point, primitive cell, symmetry tolerance, and degeneracy handling.
Do not assign spectroscopy activity without the required selection-rule evidence.
irreducible-representations.caution: A symmetry label alone does not establish mode stability or experimental observability.

checks: Retain source band.yaml hash, units, segment boundaries, and labels.
bandplot-text.caution: Conversion does not validate the underlying band calculation.

checks: Document grouping, primitive-cell atom mapping, units, and source-data hash.
pdos-plot.caution: A visually plausible plot does not check projection completeness or DOS convergence.

checks: Validate the dielectric/Born parent calculation, primitive axes, atom mapping, acoustic charge sum, and tensor symmetrization choice.
Retain stdout in a reviewed BORN file and hash it.
vasp-born.caution: The helper symmetrizes by default; use --nost only with a documented reason and compare tensors.

required_files: at least five ordered thermal_properties.yaml files

checks: Require at least five volume points and exact volume/file ordering.
Use matching temperature ranges and steps with one extra high-temperature point for numerical differentiation.
Converge electronic energies and every volume's phonons; inspect EOS fit stability and imaginary modes.
qha.caution: The shell-brace filename example is represented as an ordered placeholder here; expand and inspect the actual file list before running. QHA does not provide a full anisotropic free-energy minimization.

checks: Fully relax each cell at its constrained volume and preserve one-to-one atom/cell correspondence.
Check central volume and symmetric volume increments, mode connection, and divergence near Gamma.
Converge each underlying phonon calculation.
mode-gruneisen-mesh.caution: Do not transfer the removed main-phonopy --nac rule to phonopy-gruneisen without inspecting exact helper help; official pages are inconsistent.
